summary: This directory centralizes the structural layout logic for form components. By providing headless abstractions, it enables developers to define how form fields and containers are organized and composed without enforcing specific visual styles or CSS implementation.
responsibilities: Define structural arrangement of form elements
Provide layout wrappers for individual form fields
Expose type definitions for form layout properties
relationships: The FormLayout acts as a container for organizing fields, while the FieldLayout defines the specific placement logic for individual inputs within that form.
Type definitions provide the schema contract for both field and container layout properties to ensure structural consistency.
designDecisions: Utilization of a headless architecture to separate structural definition from visual styling
Composition-based API for nesting child elements within layout wrappers
Exporting distinct interfaces to maintain type safety across layout implementations
